exs.definition:
n a man who was formerly a certain woman's husband
n a woman who was formerly a particular man's wife
n the 24th letter of the Roman alphabet
exs.translation: abbr. 目的港船上交货价（Ex Ship）

exsanguinate.translation:
vt. 使放血, 抽血
vi. 流血至死

exsanguine.definition: s destitute of blood or apparently so
exsanguine.translation:
a. 无血的, 失血的, 贫血症的
[医] 无血的

exscind.definition:
v. t. To cut off; to separate or expel from union; to
   extirpate.

exscinded.translation: v. 割开, 切除, 切断( exscind的过去式和过去分词 )

exscinding.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Exscind
exscinding.translation: v. 割开, 切除, 切断( exscind的现在分词 )

exscutellate.definition:
a. Without, or apparently without, a scutellum; -- said
   of certain insects.

exsect.definition:
v. t. A cutting out or away.
v. t. The removal by operation of a portion of a limb;
   particularly, the removal of a portion of a bone in the vicinity of a
   joint; the act or process of cutting out.

exsert.translation:
vt. 使突出, 使伸出
a. 突出的

exserted.translation: a. 伸出的, 突出的

exsertile.definition: a. Capable of being thrust out or protruded.
exsertile.translation: a. 可伸出的, 可突出的

exserting.translation: v. 使突出, 使伸出( exsert的现在分词 )

exserts.translation: v. 使突出, 使伸出( exsert的第三人称单数 )

exsiccant.definition:
a. Having the quality of drying up; causing a drying up.
n. An exsiccant medicine.

exsiccate.translation:
vt. 使干燥
[医] 使干燥, 脱[结晶]水

exsiccated.translation: v. 使干燥( exsiccate的过去式和过去分词 )

exsiccates.translation: v. 使干燥( exsiccate的第三人称单数 )

exsiccating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Exsiccate
exsiccating.translation: v. 使干燥( exsiccate的现在分词 )

exsiccation.definition:
n. The act of operation of drying; evaporation or
   expulsion of moisture; state of being dried up; dryness.
exsiccation.translation:
n. 干燥, 干燥作用, 除湿作用, 干燥法
[医] 干燥[法], 结晶脱水

exsiccative.definition: a. Tending to make dry; having the power of drying.
exsiccative.translation:
a. 使干燥的, 除湿的
n. 干燥剂

exsiccator.definition:
n. An apparatus for drying substances or preserving them
   from moisture; a desiccator; also, less frequently, an agent employed
   to absorb moisture, as calcium chloride, or concentrated sulphuric
   acid.
exsiccator.translation:
[化] 保干器
[医] 干燥器

exsilentio.translation: <拉>缺乏反证(或证据、资料等),在无反证的情况下

exstrophy.definition:
n. The eversion or turning out of any organ, or of its
   inner surface; as, exstrophy of the eyelid or of the bladder.

exsuccous.definition: a. Destitute of juice; dry; sapless. Latham.

exsuction.definition: n. The act of sucking out.

exsufflate.definition: v. t. To exorcise or renounce by blowing.

exsufflation.definition:
n. A blast from beneath.
n. A kind of exorcism by blowing with the breath.
n. A strongly forced expiration of air from the lungs.
